Alchemist's Ledger

Sign in to save your collection, decks and logs to your own Google Drive, so they follow you across devices.

Your data is stored in a private folder in your own Drive. It isn't sent anywhere else, and this site never sees your Google password.

Data stays on this device only, and may be cleared by your browser.

Deck Builder

Builds the strongest deck your library allows, weighing combos, card level, duplicate falloff and the orbs fused cards bring (Fusion buff). Fusing adds no combo value itself.

Recommended Deck

Benchmark is the same deck with no fusion bonus, duplicate falloff or level penalty — the gap is what your fusion and levelling are worth.

Pack Name, Date is enough — each pack always yields the same cards, so both are filled in automatically. Add them as third and fourth columns only to override. Paste CSV or straight from a spreadsheet, or upload a .csv. A header row is skipped. Dates accept 2026-01-04, 1/4/26 or 4 Jan 2026.
